headline: Bitcoin is back above $61,000 and could end a seven-week losing streak after about $7 billion of options expired on Deribit, while US bitcoin funds stay on course for their worst month on record.

market.asOf: Read from CoinMarketCap's cryptocurrency list at about 11:57 UTC Fri 27 Nov (18:57 Bangkok). Use the live prices on this page.
market.fearGreed: Alternative.me's index reads 11 out of 100 ("Extreme Fear", 13 a day earlier); CoinMarketCap's Fear and Greed Index reads 10 ("Extreme fear"). Read about 11:57 UTC Fri 27 Nov.

stories.title: Bitcoin climbs back above $61,000 and could snap a seven-week losing streak
stories.summary: Bitcoin rose on Friday alongside a rebound in US stock futures, after about $7 billion of bitcoin options expired on Deribit at 08:00 UTC. A higher weekly close would end its second-longest run of weekly losses on record, but November is still its worst month since June.
points: Bitcoin was around $61,600, up 1.8% since midnight UTC, and up about 0.6% for the week, per CoinDesk.
A weekly gain would end seven straight weekly losses, the second-longest such streak on record, per CoinDesk.
About $7 billion of bitcoin options expired on Deribit at 08:00 UTC, with traders positioned defensively, per CoinDesk.
Bitcoin is down about 20% in November, its worst month since June, per CoinDesk.
Crypto liquidations fell 61% to $242 million, and 71% of them hit short sellers (traders betting on falls), per CoinDesk.

sources.label: CoinDesk: bitcoin on course to end seven-week losing streak

stories.title: US bitcoin funds head for a record-bad month, and Strategy leaves MSCI's indexes on Monday
stories.summary: November withdrawals from US spot bitcoin funds have already set a record, even as the price bounces. Index funds tracking MSCI must sell Strategy (MSTR) shares by Monday's close, while JPMorgan reads Strategy's record-low value against its bitcoin as capitulation (sellers giving up).
points: US spot bitcoin funds lost a net $453.12 million on Wed 25 Nov, the seventh straight day of outflows; BlackRock's IBIT accounted for $329.71 million, per Bitcoin.com News.
Outflows total $3.05 billion over seven days and $5.39 billion in November, a monthly record, per Bitcoin.com News. US markets were shut on Thursday for Thanksgiving.
US spot ether funds lost $68.51 million on Wednesday, all from BlackRock's ETHA, per Bitcoin.com News.
Strategy's mNAV (market value divided by the value of its bitcoin) fell to a record-low 0.88 on 25 Nov, which JPMorgan said signals capitulation in bitcoin, per The Block.
MSCI's removal of Strategy takes effect after the close on Mon 30 Nov; MSCI-linked funds hold about 13 million shares (3.1%), and JPMorgan estimated about $2.8 billion of selling, per Cointelegraph.

sources.label: Bitcoin.com News: bitcoin ETFs lose $3.05B in 7 days
The Block: JPMorgan sees bitcoin capitulation in Strategy's low NAV

stories.title: Binance fully lifts its withdrawal freeze four weeks after the $6.3 billion hack
stories.summary: Binance, the world's biggest crypto exchange, says withdrawals are back to normal after the 29 October hack. Withdrawals had been reopening in stages, and a few networks remain paused for maintenance.
points: Binance said "the withdrawal suspension from the October security incident has been fully lifted", per CoinDesk.
The hack affected about $6.3 billion in assets, of which about $3 billion was frozen, per CoinDesk.
Binance said it had restored 90% of the stolen crypto by 31 Oct, using company funds and its SAFU emergency reserve, and 98% of the $6.34 billion by 3 Nov, per CoinDesk.
Withdrawals for a small number of networks are still temporarily paused for maintenance or planned upgrades, per Binance via CoinDesk.
TRM Labs linked the attack to North Korea's TraderTraitor group, and the FBI also pointed to North Korea, per CoinDesk.

sources.label: CoinDesk: Binance says its withdrawal suspension is over

briefs.title: Monero has its worst day in over five months
briefs.summary: XMR fell more than 11% on Thursday, touching $430; KuCoin says it will delist XMR trading pairs at 08:00 UTC on 30 Nov, per CoinDesk.

briefs.title: Democratic senators ask the SEC to pull its crypto plans
briefs.summary: Sens. Warren and Van Hollen asked SEC Chair Atkins to withdraw "Regulation Crypto Assets" and the tokenized-securities innovation exemption, saying they let crypto firms bypass securities laws, per The Block.

briefs.title: Bitcoin reserve bill moves to the full House
briefs.summary: The House Financial Services Committee advanced the American Reserve Modernization Act of 2026, which would write the Strategic Bitcoin Reserve into law and bar selling its bitcoin for at least 20 years; little time is left before Congress adjourns, per The Block.

briefs.title: Standard Chartered's Zodia Custody reports a data breach
briefs.summary: An unauthorized party accessed some client names and emails, and Zodia reported no unauthorized transactions, per Decrypt.

briefs.title: Injective asks the SEC to allow order books for tokenized stocks
briefs.summary: Injective asked the SEC to extend its proposed innovation exemption for tokenized US stocks to on-chain order-book venues, not just liquidity pools, per CoinDesk.

briefs.title: Brazil's stock exchange and big banks plan a real-backed stablecoin
briefs.summary: B3 and six firms including Itaú, Bradesco and Santander plan Open BRL, a stablecoin backed 1:1 by Brazilian reais, expected in the first quarter of 2027, per CoinDesk.

briefs.title: Next ECB chief favors tokenized bank deposits
briefs.summary: Pablo Hernández de Cos, nominated to succeed Christine Lagarde, favors tokenized bank deposits over stablecoins and bitcoin, per CoinDesk.

briefs.title: Ethereum sets a test date for its Glamsterdam upgrade
briefs.summary: Developers scheduled Glamsterdam for the Hoodi test network on 15 Dec at 19:12 UTC; no main-network date is set, per The Block.

calendar.event: US stock markets close early after Thanksgiving
calendar.note: Stocks close at 1:00pm ET, per NYSE; SIFMA recommends a 2:00pm ET early close for US bond markets.

calendar.event: Binance Blockchain Week, Bangkok; Fed quiet period begins
calendar.note: At the Queen Sirikit National Convention Center, per VentureSquare. The Fed's pre-meeting blackout runs from Sat 28 Nov to Thu 10 Dec, per PropDataLab's Fed blackout calendar.

calendar.event: Token unlocks: PROS, GRASS, FF, CARDS, GRVT, KMNO, GUN, EIGEN, SUI, M, BTW, ENA, 2Z, Q, STO, MMT, LA
calendar.note: PROS and GRASS on Saturday 28; FF and CARDS on Sunday 29; GRVT, KMNO and GUN on Monday 30 (one tracker gives GUN on the 29th); EIGEN and SUI on Tuesday 1 Dec; M, BTW, ENA, 2Z and Q on Wednesday 2 Dec (M's date is disputed: Tokenomist shows 12 Dec); STO on Thursday 3 Dec; MMT and LA on Friday 4 Dec. See the unlock table on this page for sizes and confidence. (Dates from this desk's unlock data.)
October was 55.3 (September 58.8), per Newsquawk. Release time per MNI.

calendar.event: Trump Media (DJT) noteholders can demand repayment
calendar.note: Holders of its convertible notes can require the company to buy them back for cash; about $883.5 million is outstanding after a $100 million buyback, and its filing warns it may need to sell bitcoin to fund repurchases, per CoinDesk.

calendar.event: MSCI removes Strategy (MSTR) from its indexes
calendar.note: Takes effect after the close on 30 Nov. MSCI-linked funds hold about 13 million MSTR shares, about 3.1% of the total; JPMorgan estimated about $2.8 billion of selling, per Cointelegraph.

calendar.event: ISM manufacturing PMI (Nov), job openings (JOLTS, Oct); Fed's Bowman testifies to the House
calendar.note: ISM: October was 55.5, per ISM; Wells Fargo expects 53.8, per ActionForex. JOLTS: September was about 7.5 million, per AP via KSAT; the BLS schedules October's release for 10:00am. Fed Vice Chair for Supervision Michelle Bowman testifies at the House Financial Services "Oversight of Prudential Regulators" hearing, per the Fed's calendar. CrowdStrike reports after the close, per its investor page; Marvell reports the same day, with its call at 4:30pm ET, per its investor page.

calendar.event: ADP private payrolls (Nov); Salesforce and Snowflake earnings
calendar.note: ADP's release is at 8:15am ET; October was +86,000, per ADP's release on Finviz. Salesforce and Snowflake report after the close, per their investor pages.

calendar.event: US jobless claims; ISM services PMI (Nov); Nvidia's Huang before the Senate
calendar.note: Claims fell to 189,000 in the week to 21 Nov, per Stock Analysis. ISM services: October was 54.5, per investingLive; Wells Fargo expects 54.9, per ActionForex. The Senate Banking Committee chairman asked Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang to appear on 3 Dec, per Fortune.

Economists polled by LSEG expect +90,000 jobs and unemployment at 4.1%, per Reuters via AOL; Wells Fargo expects +80,000. October payrolls rose 165,000 and unemployment was 4.1%, per AP via ABC11. Release at 8:30am ET, per the BLS.

Markets expect a rate hike, not a cut: the Fed is "widely expected to raise interest rates by a quarter percentage point", per Reuters via AOL, and CME FedWatch showed a 94.4% chance of a quarter-point hike on 25 Nov, per Admiral Markets. The Fed's calendar lists the meeting at 2:00pm ET and the press conference at 2:30pm ET.
